postings.title: 2027 EU Chess Academy Interest Form
postings.description:
What if your next chess move took you to Amsterdam to play a world-class grandmaster?

The Chess Academy Europe is a one-of-a-kind programme open to all students across universities in the EU and the UK, whether you're a seasoned competitor or just love the game. In partnership with Team Liquid, IMC is bringing together the brightest student chess players in Europe for a chance to qualify through an online Swiss-format tournament on Chess.com and, if you advance, travel to Amsterdam to compete in the championship finals against the best student players on the continent.

This is more than a chess tournament. It's an opportunity to step inside one of the world's leading trading firms, connect with IMC's traders, researchers and technologists, and experience what it's like to think fast, compete hard, and perform under pressure. These are the skills that define both great chess players and the people who thrive at the world's top trading firms.

What You'll Do

- Compete at the highest level: Qualify through an online Swiss-format tournament on Chess.com and, if you advance, travel to Amsterdam to compete in the championship finals against the best student players in Europe.

- Play a world-class grandmaster: All finalists take part in a showmatch experience with an elite grandmaster — a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to sit across the board from one of the game's best.

- Learn from the best: Finalists will take part in an exclusive masterclass led by top grandmasters, an opportunity to hear how the world's elite players think about the game.

- Go behind the scenes at IMC: Tour IMC's Amsterdam office and get a firsthand look at the environment where some of the world's fastest and most sophisticated trading takes place.

- Build your network: Connect directly with IMC traders, researchers, technologists, and recruiters. Whether or not a career in trading is on your radar, this is a rare chance to meet and learn from world-class professionals.

Ready to Apply?

Applications aren't open yet — register your interest through the form below and we'll be in touch in January when applications open.

Open to all enrolled students regardless of chess rating or experience level, and all majors and academic backgrounds. If you love the game and want to test yourself against the best, we want to hear from you.

postings.title: Accounts Payable Officer
postings.description:
The AP Officer will join IMC’s Finance team in Sydney, working directly with the AP Supervisor to run accounts payable, payments and settlements across multiple legal entities in various APAC jurisdictions, with multi-currency payments in AUD, USD, HKD, KRW and JPY. The role sits within a lean, two-person AP operations team and plays a critical part in ensuring supplier payments, intercompany settlements and the daily cash movements that keep a trading business running are accurate, controlled and on time.

Two near-term priorities shape the role: AP automation, where you will own the exception queue and help tune the process in Workday Financials until most invoices flow straight through; and building resilience into our operations, so payments and settlements run cleanly every day, including when a colleague is away. This is not a shared-services AP role. It is a broad and substantive role from day one in a lean, high-performing team where you will own real outcomes and work closely with the Finance Managers, the Financial Controller and Treasury.

Your Core Responsibilities

Accounts Payable

- Process supplier invoices end-to-end in Workday, coding to the correct entity, cost centre and GL account, and routing for approval

- Own the AP exception queue, resolving coding, matching and approval exceptions directly with budget owners rather than escalating them

- Handle cross-entity invoices

- Maintain supplier master data and independently verify new or changed supplier bank details before any payment is released

- Respond to supplier queries with remittances; reconcile supplier statements and resolve differences

Payments & Settlements

- Prepare the weekly payment run and daily settlement runs, both EFT and manual payments, with complete supporting documentation for independent review and dual approval

- Prepare intercompany settlements and funding requests across APAC entities, and work through payment differences with the Finance team

- Process tax, statutory and charity payments on instruction from the Finance team, on time and to deadline

Treasury Operations

- Set up intra-group and onward cash transfers on Treasury’s instruction across multiple banks and currencies, and track each one through to settlement

- Investigate returned, rejected or unidentified payments, including SWIFT queries, beneficiary details and correspondent bank issues, and resolve them with the bank

- Support bank administration, including account forms, signatory and user changes, KYC and periodic reviews, and follow up with banks until closed

- Escalate early: anything stuck with a bank or counterparty beyond agreed timeframes goes to the AP Supervisor with a clear summary and proposed next step

Month-End, Controls & Automation

- Support month-end close, including AP cut-off, accrual inputs, and AP sub-ledger and bank reconciliations

- Apply correct GST and indirect tax treatment on invoices, including foreign-supplier invoices

- Work with the AP Supervisor on AP automation, testing, refining coding rules and feeding back on exceptions to raise the straight-through processing rate

- Document procedures as runbooks so every process can be picked up by another team member

Your Skills and Experience

- 2-6 years of experience across accounts payable and payments or treasury operations

- Experience preparing payment runs and reconciling bank accounts in a multi-entity environment

- Working knowledge of tax invoice requirements

- Strong Excel skills and high attention to detail, comfortable handling large, multi-currency payment values

- Confident following up with banks, suppliers and senior stakeholders until items are closed

- Workday Financials experience, or another ERP such as SAP, Oracle or NetSuite, is preferred but not required

- Experience with cross-border, multi-currency payments and familiarity with SWIFT messages is an advantage but not required

- Exposure to banking in Hong Kong, Korea or Singapore is an advantage but not required

- Exposure to AP automation, OCR or invoice-capture tools is an advantage but not required

- An owner, not a router, resolving exceptions yourself and escalating only what needs a decision

- Control-minded, never releasing a payment without the right approval and always checking bank details properly

- Calm under time pressure, planning around value dates and bank cut-offs

- Quick to escalate, raising a stuck item in days, not weeks

- Curious about technology and process improvement, with an interest in automation

postings.title: AML/KYC Officer - Digital Assets
postings.description:
We are looking for an experienced AML Officer to support AML/KYC activities relating to IMC’s crypto counterparties and digital asset business activities.

This role requires a strong understanding of AML/CTF risks associated with crypto markets, including exposure to high-risk counterparties, complex ownership structures, sanctions risk and enhanced due diligence requirements. The successful candidate must be capable of independently conducting risk assessments, challenging counterparties where necessary and applying a pragmatic, risk-based approach in a fast-moving environment. The role requires strong analytical judgement and the ability to independently assess and challenge complex counterparty risks in a fast-moving and evolving regulatory environment. You will combine analytical work with direct interaction with counterparties, front office teams and internal stakeholders.

Your Core Responsibilities

AML/KYC Counterparty Reviews

- Perform customer due diligence (CDD) and periodic reviews for crypto counterparties

- Conduct risk-based counterparty reviews with exposure to enhanced due diligence (EDD) requirements

- Analyze complex ownership and control structures, including offshore and layered structures where relevant

- Assess AML/CTF and sanctions risks associated with counterparties, products and jurisdictions

- Manage escalations relating to high-risk counterparties and onboarding matters

- Conduct independent AML/KYC risk assessments and determine appropriate risk classifications

- Prepare high-risk cases and escalation memos for senior stakeholder approval

Screening & Risk Analysis

- Conduct adverse media and sanctions screening using relevant screening tools

- Identify and assess AML/CTF and sanctions-related red flags associated with crypto counterparties and digital asset activities

- Review wallet-related information and blockchain intelligence outputs where applicable

- Provide AML/CTF subject matter expertise on onboarding and counterparty risk matters

Stakeholder & Counterparty Engagement

- Engage directly with counterparties regarding AML/KYC requirements and documentation requests

- Work closely with Trading, Legal, Compliance and operational teams on onboarding and risk matters

- Provide practical AML guidance to internal stakeholders on crypto-related risks and controls

- Governance & Regulatory Support

- Support AML/KYC enhancement initiatives and control improvements

- Draft and maintain AML/CTF policies, procedures and guidance materials

- Assist with internal audits, regulatory reviews and remediation actions

- Remain current on AML/CTF regulatory developments, sanctions frameworks and industry expectations relevant to digital assets

Governance & Regulatory Support

- Support AML/KYC enhancement initiatives and control improvements

- Draft and maintain AML/CTF policies, procedures and guidance materials

- Assist with internal audits, regulatory reviews and remediation actions

- Remain current on AML/CTF regulatory developments, sanctions frameworks and industry expectations relevant to digital assets

Key deliverables

- Timely and accurate completion of CDD analyses and periodic counterparty reviews

- Effective handling of counterparty KYC requests and communications

- Risk-based analysis of adverse media and sanctions screening alerts

- Reliable and well-documented AML transaction monitoring

- Up-to-date compliance policies, procedures, and documentation

Your Skills and Experience: 

- 4+ years of AML/KYC/CDD experience within crypto, trading, banking, payment institutions or other regulated financial institutions

- Strong understanding of enhanced due diligence (EDD) requirements and risk-based AML/KYC assessments

- Prior familiarity with AML/CTF risks and typologies relevant to digital assets and crypto markets is preferred (but not mandatory)

- Experience conducting independent risk assessments and exercising sound judgement

- Familiarity with crypto transaction tracing and wallet screening tools is preferred

- Knowledge of relevant AML/CTF legislation, including sanctions frameworks

- Experience dealing with complex legal entity structures and institutional counterparties

- CAMS certification preferred; crypto-related AML certifications are a plus

- Strong analytical and investigative mindset

- Ability to independently manage complex AML/KYC matters from onboarding through ongoing monitoring

- Confident communicator, capable of interacting directly with counterparties and senior stakeholders

- Pragmatic and risk-based approach to problem solving

- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving regulatory environment

- High level of ownership, accountability and attention to detail

What we offer

- A high-impact role in a small, expert team holding significant regulatory responsibility

- A collaborative, high-performance culture that rewards ownership and initiative

- Exposure to AML operations across multiple jurisdictions

- Support to obtain CAMS certification if not already held

postings.title: ASIC Implementation Specialist
postings.description:
As an ASIC Implementation Specialist in our Global Hardware R&D team, you’ll help expand IMC’s ASIC capabilities, building on our existing technology to accelerate time-to-market.

You’ll work on greenfield projects spanning cutting-edge research and production-scale implementations, with multiple overlapping projects each year. This is an opportunity to help shape the future of ASICs at IMC and contribute to technology that will support our trading systems over the next decade.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

- Take ownership of blocks throughout the RTL-to-GDSII back-end flow: synthesis, floorplanning, clock-tree synthesis, timing optimization and signoff.

- Design floorplans and power grids, making key decisions around macro and pin placement, area budgeting and clock-tree optimization.

- Drive STA and timing closure for high-performance designs, developing and validating the SDC constraints needed to achieve design goals.

- Ensure designs are ready for signoff through power integrity analysis, physical verification, logic equivalence checking and ECOs.

- Shape and improve implementation flows around design needs, building automation and scripts that support efficient execution.

- Work closely with RTL design, DFT, packaging and foundry teams, using physical implementation insights to influence and improve RTL.

- Share your expertise through design reviews and clear documentation.

Your Skills and Experience: 

Required Experience:

- BS/MS in Electrical or Computer Engineering, with 7+ years of ASIC implementation experience and multiple successful tapeouts.

- Strong experience across physical implementation and signoff, including floorplanning, clock-tree synthesis, STA, timing closure and physical verification.

- Hands-on experience with Cadence and Siemens implementation and signoff tools.

- Strong understanding of CMOS, RC-parasitic extraction and key physical design formats and constraints.

- Experience with low-power design flow.

- DFT awareness.

- Advanced FinFET nodes experience (16/12/7/5).

Preferred Experience:

- Experience with custom macro integration.

- Knowledge of package/PCB co-design, chiplet or 2.5D/3D integration.

- Exposure to machine-learning-driven implementation flows.

- RTL coding ability and functional verification experience.

- Synthesis and DFT experience.

postings.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
postings.description:
IMC is currently looking for an energetic and team-oriented Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Business Planning & Analysis (BP&A) Team. The BP&A Team is responsible for reporting and analytics across all teams at IMC including Trading, Finance, Mid Office, and HR. You will work together to understand their needs and provide them with meaningful insights through data analysis and reporting. As a BP&A team member, you will create reporting and analysis that has a global impact. Your projects will include collaboration with teammates in both our Sydney and Amsterdam offices. Together, you will analyze big data and extract valuable information, making it readily available in the decision making process. You will also get the benefit of seeing the full data cycle from extraction to modelling, visualization and, and finally presenting the results. 

The ideal candidate acts as a true partner to the business and is both technical and business-savvy, displaying strong analytical and interpersonal skills. 

You’ll be responsible for:

- Execution and implementation of all (Global) BP&A aspects of strategic company projects.

- Database development, maintenance, ETL process improvement and automation (ETLs mainly in python, json, qlik (bnf)).

- Report development and maintenance in BI tooling in line with business requirements.

- Managing the pipeline from development to production for the data and reporting layers.

- You will act as a true partner to all areas of the business in our Sydney office - working across all departments in the business to identify and collect requirements to support any analysis / reporting needs.

- We strive to create cohesive global teams and in addition to the local team in Sydney, you will closely collaborate with teams in Amsterdam and Chicago.

You’ll likely bring to the table:

- Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics or other quantitative backgrounds (Preferred).

- 5+ years of relevant work experience in data analysis / business intelligence.

- Strong Python commercial experience (PyCharm experience preferred but not essential).

- Experience with developing business reporting applications (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Qlikview / Qlik Sense).

- Proficiency in SQL.

- Experience with Git and JIRA preferred.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Interest in and preferably exposure to finance processes.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

- Strong business acumen, and someone who thrives within a dynamic, quickly changing environment.

postings.title: Commodities Analyst
postings.description:
Our Analyst team plays a central role in the trading desk’s decision-making. We’re looking for a Commodities Analyst to turn market fundamentals into actionable trading insight. You’ll work closely with traders, quantitative researchers and technologists, delivering real-time analysis during market events and in-depth fundamental research that shapes our trading strategies across global commodity markets.

You’ll build and maintain a clear view of supply, demand and inventories across the markets we trade, and translate that view into what matters for trading: price direction, curve structure, spreads and volatility. This role is key to helping the desk trade quickly, accurately and confidently in a highly competitive environment.

Your Core Responsibilities

- Conduct fundamental, macroeconomic and geopolitical analysis across global commodity markets, with a focus on energy (crude oil, refined products, LNG), petrochemicals, base metals and coal.

- Build and maintain supply and demand balance models, including production, consumption, inventories and trade flows, to form forward-looking views on market tightness.

- Develop a deep understanding of commodity value chains, including production costs, refining and processing margins, and the links between upstream feedstocks and downstream products.

- Analyse what drives futures curve structure, calendar spreads, inter-commodity spreads and regional price differentials, and how fundamental shifts are reflected across the curve.

- Track inventory data, shipping and freight, plant outages, seasonal demand patterns and other market-moving information, and provide fast, clear analysis of data releases and news events.

- Monitor regulatory changes, trade policy, sanctions and government interventions across major producing and consuming regions.

- Identify and evaluate upcoming catalysts and structural changes, and work with traders to turn them into trading ideas based on expected direction and volatility. - Develop and maintain data models, dashboards and research tools using Python, SQL and other analytics platforms.

Your Skills and Experience

- 3+ years in a commodities-focused analytical role at a buy-side or sell-side firm, trading house, producer, consultancy or similar. Exposure to Asian markets is a plus.

- A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data Science or a related quantitative field.

- A strong understanding of global commodity markets, value chains and the macroeconomic factors that drive them.

- Experience building commodity balance models and interpreting fundamental data such as inventories, production, trade flows and margins.

- A working understanding of futures curves, spreads and how fundamentals translate into price and volatility.

- Proficiency in Python and SQL for data handling, modelling and visualisation. - Familiarity with Bloomberg, Kpler, Vortexa or other market intelligence and data platforms.

- Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

postings.title: Equity Analyst
postings.description:
Our Analyst team is integral in helping the trading team make decisions, the team sits on the trading floor and helps the trading team make fast, well informed decisions. The team is passionate about stocks, stock indices, and the options trading environment, and thrive on the process of researching and predicting how equities and derivatives will react in certain scenarios and regimes. When news breaks, a stock gaps or volatility spikes, you'll be the one the desk turns to for the "why" and the "what next".

We're seeking an Equity Analyst with a trader's instincts to join the team, preferably with experience covering Hong Kong and China equities. Your input will directly shape the positions we put on and how we manage risk around market events, often within minutes rather than weeks.

Your Core Responsibilities:

- Share responsibility for covering a universe of around 100 large- and mid-cap stocks listed in Hong Kong.

- Monitor news flow across your coverage in real time: corporate, industry, regulatory, policy and macro developments. Quickly assess what matters, what's priced in and how the market is likely to react.

- Identify what's driving price and volatility moves, whether that's earnings, flows, policy headlines, positioning or sentiment. Explain it clearly to the trading desk.

- Generate short-term trading ideas based on expected volatility and direction, and work closely with the options traders to execute them.

- Anticipate, monitor and evaluate upcoming catalysts, including earnings, dividends, corporate actions, index events and special situations. Help the desk prepare for them before they happen.

- Build and maintain a working knowledge of your stocks and their peers, so you can form a view quickly when events hit.

Your Skills and Experience:

- 5+ years of experience as an Equity Analyst in sell-side or buy-side equity research.

- A strong sense of urgency and the ability to form clear, actionable views quickly, often with incomplete information.

- A demonstrated passion for markets and an instinct for what's moving them day to day.

- Comfort in a fast-moving, high-pressure, competitive trading environment.

- Able to combine quantitative data with qualitative insight to reach a conclusion fast.

- Fluent in English, written and spoken. Mandarin fluency is a plus.

- Derivatives and/or structured products experience is advantageous.

- Tertiary qualified. CFA is a plus.

- Bloomberg and Python experience preferred.

As a culture ambassador and someone who makes things happen, you will bring the experience and judgment to independently plan and deliver outstanding, high-visibility experiences for our employees — from an all-hands trip that brings our US teams together, to the firm wide celebrations that make IMC a great place to work.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

- Support the Annual Company Trip: partner closely with our Events Manager to plan and deliver our Annual Company Trip, where we bring all US employees together for a weekend to connect, celebrate our success, and build shared memories that strengthen the IMC culture, including attending site visits, sourcing and evaluating venues and vendors, supporting travel and accommodation logistics, and providing hands-on execution and on-site delivery.

- Plan and Deliver Firm-Wide Events: plan, execute and provide on-site support for our firm-wide events throughout the year, including the Summer Family BBQ, Holiday Parties, Partner Events, and similar celebrations. For your events, you'll develop themes where relevant, manage decor, catering, entertainment and venue sourcing, manage vendor negotiation end-to-end, and own the event budget from planning through reconciliation.

- Report on your Events: build and present post-event reports for the firm-wide events you plan and execute, covering budget reconciliation, attendance, feedback, and ROI; translate findings into concrete recommendations that improve future events and inform planning for the next cycle.

- Manage Events Administration: oversee the day-to-day logistics and administrative details that keep events running smoothly, including invoicing and budget tracking, vendor contracts, RSVP systems, event calendars, and event materials.

- Manage Vendor Relationships: build, negotiate, and maintain relationships with venues, caterers, entertainers, and decor vendors for the firm-wide events you own. You'll also support vendor sourcing and evaluation for the annual company trip, working alongside our Events Manager, with an eye toward cost efficiency and quality throughout.

- Coordinate Cross-Functionally: partner with our Procurement, Legal, Facilities, Workplace, and HR teams as needed to manage contracts, approvals, space needs, and other resources required to bring your events to life.

- Support Ad hoc and One-off events: step in on special, non-recurring events as they arise throughout the year (for example, hosting corporate guests and clients at a private suite during a high-profile event like the Presidents Cup). - Partner with the Wider Events Team: work closely with our other Events Planner to provide coverage and support across the broader events calendar and for ad-hoc project work where needed, and help shape the overall events strategy.

- 5+ years of experience in events management, ideally including ownership of large-scale, multi-day, or employee travel/offsite events.

- A track record of owning event budgets end-to-end, including vendor negotiation and cost management.

- Strong time management skills and the ability to run multiple complex projects simultaneously.

- Extremely well-organized with excellent multi-tasking abilities.

- Agility and flexibility in response to changing priorities and needs.

- A collaborative mindset — focused on sharing ownership of the events calendar and coordinating closely with the Events team.

postings.title: Head of Procurement - APAC
postings.description:
IMC is seeking a Head of Procurement, APAC to lead the procurement function across the Asia Pacific region. This is a newly created role reporting into the APAC CFO, with a dotted line to the Global Head of Procurement. The successful candidate will own regional procurement strategy, build and lead the APAC team, and act as the senior commercial partner to the business across technology, infrastructure and corporate spend.

The role owns the commercial outcomes, supplier relationships and procurement execution that APAC depends on, with direct accountability to regional leadership. It is also one of IMC's regional procurement leads and is expected to help shape and then adopt a shared operating model, so that IMC negotiates as one firm with suppliers who serve it in every region.

The role covers procurement across all APAC categories. Corporate and indirect spend is already well covered by an established team, so the emphasis of this hire is IT and technology procurement. IMC's technology spend is growing quickly and is concentrated in seller-led markets: data centres and exchange colocation, compute and GPU infrastructure, networking, low-latency connectivity, market data and enterprise software. The successful candidate brings real depth in these categories and the commercial judgement to negotiate at scale in them.

Core Responsibilities

Regional leadership 

- Own procurement strategy for APAC, aligned to regional business priorities and to the global procurement operating model.

- Act as the senior procurement partner to APAC leadership, including the regional CFO and technology leadership, on all significant commercial decisions.

- Build, lead and develop the APAC procurement team. Set priorities and coverage, and raise the capability of the function over time.

- Represent APAC in global procurement forums and own the regional input into global category strategies and supplier negotiations.

Technology and infrastructure sourcing

- Lead sourcing and negotiation across IT categories: data centres and colocation, compute and GPU infrastructure, networking hardware, low-latency connectivity, cross-connects and telecommunications, market data, and enterprise software and cloud.

- Partner daily with engineering, platform, data centre and infrastructure teams to translate technical requirements into sourcing strategies and commercial outcomes.

- Run structured RFI, RFP and RFQ processes: define requirements, evaluate responses, and drive to a documented award recommendation.

- Negotiate OEM, VAR and reseller agreements covering pricing, lead times, allocation, service levels and lifecycle support.

- Track supply constraints, OEM roadmaps, allocation dynamics and pricing trends across the region, and turn that into actionable intelligence for stakeholders.

- Own the logistics of regional hardware procurement, including freight, customs and import duties, delivery to site, and the entity and invoicing structure for cross-border purchases.

Commercial negotiation and contracting

- Lead negotiations on the region's most significant agreements, including multi-year commitments, renewals and enterprise frameworks.

- Surface and manage commercial risk in contract terms, including commitment and shortfall structures, auto-renewal and notice windows, termination rights, guarantees and liability provisions.

- Work with Legal, Finance, Risk and Compliance to finalise terms through IMC's contract intake and review process.

- Maintain visibility of renewal and expiry dates across the regional portfolio, so that no agreement renews by default.

Governance, data and process

- Own accurate regional data on spend, contracts, suppliers and pipeline, and contribute it to the global reporting standard.

- Report on savings, spend against budget and supplier performance.

- Review and strengthen commercial and procurement processes across the region, including policy, approval thresholds and workflows, keeping them consistent with global standards and with local legal and regulatory requirements.

- Drive the use of AI, automation and tooling to streamline procurement, including intake, sourcing, contract review and spend analysis, so the function scales with IMC's growth.

- Run supplier performance reviews and quarterly business reviews for strategic regional suppliers, and escalate delivery, quality and pricing issues early.

- Own vendor due diligence and third-party risk assessment for new and renewing suppliers, including material outsourcing arrangements, and maintain the regional supplier and outsourcing register with Risk and Compliance.

Global alignment

- Work with the Global Head of Procurement and the other regional leads to identify consolidation opportunities and build global leverage with shared suppliers.

- Adopt global category strategies where they serve the region, and make the case for local variation where they do not.

- Contribute to global systems and tooling initiatives, including the spend and contract visibility program.

Skills and Experience

- Significant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing or supply chain, including experience leading a function or a team.

- Substantial IT and technology procurement experience, with depth in several of: data centres and colocation, enterprise compute and GPU infrastructure, networking, low-latency connectivity, market data, enterprise software and cloud.

- Proven record negotiating complex, high-value technology agreements in seller-led markets, including multi-year commitments and allocation-constrained supply.

- Experience operating in a multi-region structure, and achieving outcomes through influence rather than positional authority.

- Strong commercial judgement on contract terms, with the ability to identify where a term carries real financial exposure and to quantify it for Legal and Finance.

- Experience of third-party and vendor risk processes, including supplier due diligence and material outsourcing assessments in a regulated environment.

- Working knowledge of cross-border hardware logistics, including freight, customs and import duty exposure.

- Credibility with technical stakeholders. Able to hold a substantive conversation with engineering teams and translate their requirements into a sourcing plan.

- People leadership experience: hiring, developing and retaining procurement talent.

- Experience across the APAC region and its supplier landscape. Familiarity with Australia and at least one of Hong Kong, Singapore or China preferred.

- Comfortable with procurement systems, ERP and spend analytics. Experience improving data quality and visibility, not only consuming reports.

- Track record of improving procurement processes and adopting tooling, including AI and automation, to increase speed and reduce manual effort.

- Financial services or trading experience is an advantage but not a requirement. Comparable experience in a technology-intensive, fast-moving environment is equally relevant.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Finance or a related field.

- Professional certification such as CPSM or CIPS is preferred but not required.

postings.title: Information Security Engineer
postings.description:
The Information Security team at IMC Trading is responsible for protecting IMC's intellectual property, IT infrastructure and business operations against external and internal threats. We work closely with technology, risk, compliance, internal audit and business leaders to reduce cyber risk to acceptable levels.

We are looking for an Information Security Engineer to help grow and mature our Security Operations Centre, which runs on EDR, SIEM, SOAR, CSPM, IAM, firewalls, NIDS/NIPS and a range of other security controls. Alongside SOC work, you will play a central role in supporting IMC's regulatory obligations in India, preparing evidence and coordinating the cyber and systems audits that come with operating in this market.

We offer an environment that lets you broaden and deepen your information security knowledge, with access to advanced security technology, frequent training and a culture of knowledge sharing. As you gain experience with our existing SOC technology and processes, you will be given considerable freedom to mature the function through your own initiatives.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

- 

Analyse security logs, alerts and reported events, and respond to or assist with the remediation of incidents.

- 

Hunt for potential compromise across the infrastructure using a range of threat intelligence sources.

- 

Report discovered vulnerabilities to technology owners and recommend remediation steps.

- 

Support and improve technical security controls.

- 

Leverage automation and orchestration to remove repetitive manual work.

- 

Apply AI-assisted tooling to alert triage, event summarisation and investigation workflows, with a pragmatic view of its limitations.

- 

Develop reporting that measures the effectiveness of security controls.

- 

Develop and improve incident response playbooks.

- 

Support regulatory and assurance audits: prepare evidence, coordinate with auditors and track observations through to closure.

Your Skills and Experience: 

- 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- 

A self-starter with a genuine passion for cybersecurity.

- 

Previous SOC experience, and/or 3+ years of hands-on experience in an enterprise IT environment managing endpoints and applications on-premises or in the cloud.

- 

Exposure to security controls such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, and endpoint detection and response.

- 

Working knowledge of — or a strong willingness to learn — the Indian regulatory cybersecurity landscape: SEBI CSCRF, exchange circulars (NSE/BSE/MCX) and CERT-In directions, along with familiarity with ISO 27001 and the NIST CSF on which CSCRF is modelled.

- 

Experience supporting audits (cyber audit, systems audit, VAPT, ISO or SOC 2 assessments) — evidence preparation, auditor coordination and observation remediation — is a strong plus.

- 

Automation using basic coding skills or low-code / no-code tools.

- 

Awareness of AI and machine learning applications in security operations is a plus; hands-on experience with AI-assisted security tooling or LLM-based workflows is highly regarded.

- 

Understanding of common attack techniques and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

- 

Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into audit-ready evidence and regulator-facing reports.

- 

Relevant tertiary and/or security qualifications are a plus — for example a Bachelor's degree in information systems or computer science, CompTIA Security+, Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), CEH, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer. If you don't have them yet, you will be supported to pursue certifications on the job.

Our on-site IT Support team helps us move at a higher pace and quality each day, from hands-on support for end users to configuring and automating our systems to scale our support capabilities.

You support our growing Zug office and act as first- to third-line support. Our environment is predominantly macOS and cloud-based, with a small Windows footprint. You’ll work across a wide range of SaaS and custom systems. To succeed and grow, you take ownership, work autonomously, and keep improving an IT environment that runs smoothly and is ready to scale. 

Your Responsibilities:

- First-to-third line support for our users, mainly on macOS.

- Managing and supporting our end-user platform, including Microsoft 365, Okta (SSO, MFA, lifecycle management), Slack and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management).

- Device management and patching: Jamf for macOS and Intune for phones, including enrollment, configuration profiles, app deployment and compliance.

- Onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access management and device setup.

- Installing, setting up and servicing hardware and peripherals, including laptops, monitors, printers, and audio and video conferencing systems.

- Troubleshooting, escalating and documenting network and connectivity issues.

- Automating repetitive tasks and keeping knowledge base articles and runbooks in Confluence up to date.

- Organizing and performing desk moves, room setups and physical equipment moves.

- Everything else that keeps us moving.

Your Skills and Experience

- A degree in an ICT-related field (BSc level ideally), or an equivalent qualification such as Informatiker/in EFZ.

- At least one year of experience in a similar role in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong macOS knowledge and hands-on experience with JAMF (Pro).

- Experience with Microsoft 365 administration and Intune; working knowledge of Windows.

- Familiarity with Okta or a similar identity provider (SSO, SCIM, MFA).

- Experience administering or supporting Slack and the Atlassian suite.

postings.title: Machine Learning Engineer
postings.description:
Machine Learning Engineers at IMC play a pivotal role in building the systems that drive training and deployment of large-scale ML models across IMC's global operations. They collaborate with quantitative researchers, hardware specialists and software engineers to build robust systems that get the most out of GPU acceleration, distributed computing and the broader open-source ML ecosystem. ML Engineers' work directly shapes how fast we can experiment, iterate and deploy — accelerating the cycle that turns a research idea into a live trading strategy.

This is a unique opportunity to solve problems at the intersection of advanced machine learning and trading, where your contributions will shape the future of IMC's technology and trading capabilities.

As a team, our Machine Learning Engineers broadly work across two areas: ML Research Engineering, focused on the systems and frameworks researchers use to train, evaluate and iterate on models at scale; and ML Performance Engineering, focused on making ML workloads execute as efficiently as possible, typically through GPU and low-level systems optimization. These aren't rigid tracks, and there is overlap between them. You will bring depth of expertise in at least one of these focus areas and collaborate closely with global team members.

Your Core Responsibilities

The responsibilities below are representative of the role — the exact mix depends on your team, area of expertise and location.

ML Research Engineering

- Develop large-scale distributed training pipelines that manage complex datasets and models.

- Partner with quantitative researchers to automate ML experiments, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining.

- Work with HPC specialists to optimise workflows, improve training speed and reduce compute cost.

ML Performance Engineering

- Build and optimise low-latency inference pipelines, ensuring models deliver real-time predictions in production systems.

- Maximise performance in training and inference using GPU hardware and acceleration libraries.

Across both areas

- Extend and improve the internals of machine learning frameworks and open-source tools to raise their performance for our workloads.

- Design scalable model infrastructure capable of handling high-volume trading data and delivering real-time, high-accuracy predictions.

- Evaluate and roll out third-party tools that enhance model development, training and inference capabilities.

Your Skills and Experience

Core, regardless of focus area:

- 3+ years of experience in machine learning, with a focus on training or inference systems.

- Production software engineering — Python, testing discipline and genuine ownership of systems once they ship.

- Machine learning fundamentals — you understand modern ML workloads beyond high-level APIs and can reason about model behaviour, correctness and performance at the level relevant to your area of expertise.

- A systems mindset — you reach for measurement before opinion on performance, scale or reliability issues, and can make sound build-versus-buy decisions.

- Strong collaboration — comfortable explaining the reasoning behind your technical decisions, working through differing perspectives with researchers and adapting your approach when the evidence supports it.

Depth in one or more of the following:

- Distributed training and large-scale systems — parallelism strategy, data pipelines and checkpointing; frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX.

- GPU performance and low-level optimisation — reasoning about memory, compute and latency at the device level, and optimising performance across kernels, compilers and hardware (e.g. CUDA, Triton or equivalent).

- Production inference systems — hands-on experience building and hardening real-time, low-latency prediction pipelines in high-performance environments.

- Numerics and correctness at scale — low-precision effects, KV caching, batching, and knowing which optimisations stay bit-exact.

Technologies listed above are examples rather than requirements; equivalent depth developed using other stacks or hardware platforms is equally relevant.

Also a plus:

- Exposure to cloud platforms and orchestration tools.

- A track record of contributing to open-source projects in machine learning, data science or distributed systems.

Not sure this is the one? If your strength is mainly in modelling and research direction, our Deep Learning Researcher roles are likely a closer fit. If your strength is in general infrastructure rather than ML-specific systems, take a look at our broader infrastructure engineering roles.

Machine Learning Engineers at IMC play a pivotal role in building the systems that drive training and deployment of large-scale ML models across IMC's global operations. They collaborate with quantitative researchers, hardware specialists and software engineers to build robust systems that get the most out of GPU acceleration, distributed computing and the broader open-source ML ecosystem. ML Engineers' work directly shapes how fast we can experiment, iterate and deploy, accelerating the cycle that turns a research idea into a live trading strategy.

This is a unique opportunity to solve problems at the intersection of advanced machine learning and trading, where your contributions will shape the future of IMC's technology and trading capabilities.

As a team, our Machine Learning Engineers broadly work across two areas: ML Research Engineering, focused on the systems and frameworks researchers use to train, evaluate and iterate on models at scale; and ML Performance Engineering, focused on making ML workloads execute as efficiently as possible, typically through GPU and low-level systems optimisation. These aren't rigid tracks, and there is overlap between them. You will bring depth of expertise in at least one of these focus areas and collaborate closely with global team members.

Your Core Responsibilities:

ML Research Engineering:

- Develop large-scale distributed training pipelines that manage complex datasets and models.

- Partner with quantitative researchers to automate ML experiments, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining.

- Work with HPC specialists to optimise workflows, improve training speed and reduce compute cost.

ML Performance Engineering:

- Build and optimise low-latency inference pipelines, ensuring models deliver real-time predictions in production systems.

- Maximise performance in training and inference using GPU hardware and acceleration libraries.

Across both areas:

- Extend and improve the internals of machine learning frameworks and open-source tools to raise their performance for our workloads.

- Design scalable model infrastructure capable of handling high-volume trading data and delivering real-time, high-accuracy predictions.

- Evaluate and roll out third-party tools that enhance model development, training and inference capabilities.

Your Skills and Experience:

Core, regardless of focus area:

- 3+ years' experience in machine learning, with a focus on training or inference systems.

- Production software engineering: Python, testing discipline and genuine ownership of systems once they ship.

- Machine learning fundamentals: you understand modern ML workloads beyond high-level APIs and can reason about model behaviour, correctness and performance at the level relevant to your area of expertise.

- A systems mindset: you reach for measurement before opinion on performance, scale or reliability issues, and can make sound build-versus-buy decisions.

- Strong collaboration: comfortable explaining the reasoning behind your technical decisions, working through differing perspectives with researchers and adapting your approach when the evidence supports it.

Depth in one or more of the following:

- Distributed training and large-scale systems: parallelism strategy, data pipelines and checkpointing; frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX.

- GPU performance and low-level optimisation: reasoning about memory, compute and latency at the device level, and optimising performance across kernels, compilers and hardware (e.g. CUDA, Triton or equivalent).

- Production inference systems: hands-on experience building and hardening real-time, low-latency prediction pipelines in high-performance environments.

- Numerics and correctness at scale: low-precision effects, KV caching, batching, and knowing which optimisations stay bit-exact.

Also a plus:

- Exposure to cloud platforms and orchestration tools.

- A track record of contributing to open-source projects in machine learning, data science or distributed systems.

Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. postings.title: Macro Analyst
postings.description:
As a Macro Research Analyst on our US Index desk in Chicago, you will partner closely with Traders to identify trading opportunities in the markets for US index futures and options. Based in our Chicago office, you will be an integral part of the trading team.

You will attempt to find opportunities that other market participants may not be aware of or are interpreting in a different way. More than reporting what you see, you will translate macro context into actionable trade ideas - framing your views in probabilistic terms and with conviction, so that Traders can convert them into positions. You will work in a fastpaced, dynamic, sometimes highly pressured dealing room, and over time you may potentially be handling trades yourself.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

- Monitor markets with a focus on US equity indices and their relation to other macro products

- Monitor headlines and analysis (mainstream media, specialized Investment Bank research). Make judgement calls on its importance, impact and reliability

- Understand and react to changes in the volatility term structures in light of new trends and events 

- Spot trading opportunities across the US equity markets and translate them into actionable trade ideas 

- Look at global economic events and perform impact / scenario analysis, expressing views in probabilistic terms with clear conviction 

- Understand the possible risks and opportunities in each scenario, suggesting the best pay-off structures

- Prepare for and analyze important events (FOMC meetings, data releases, elections)

- Interact proactively with Traders to game plan trading around scenarios

- Analyze the historical performance of trade recommendations and tie research output directly to trading results

- Study time series related to the volatility of events and realized moves, to spot patterns, potential regime shifts and to build scenarios

- Monitor the relation (beta) between equity indices and their single-stock constituents 

Your Skills and Experience: 

- 

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Econometrics, STEM or a related field of study 

- 

2-4 years of work experience with Equity Index, Equity Research and/or Fixed Income Futures

- 

A strong and proven interest in financial markets, experience with options is a plus

- 

Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills

- 

Strong Excel skills

- 

Experience in programming with Python is a plus

- 

Ability to work in a fast-moving and competitive environment

- 

Strong focus on teamwork, details and accuracy

- Fluent in English

#LI-DNI

postings.title: Mid Office Analyst - Digital Assets
postings.description:
As the Crypto business is growing at IMC, we need to ensure that our post-trade processes are as scalable and efficient as possible. Hence, we are looking for a Mid Office Associate to play an important role, assisting on day-to-day post-trade operations and gathering business requirements from various stakeholders and working with developers to improve processes.

Note that this is an onsite role in Zug, Switzerland, with very limited flexibility for working from home.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

- Perform daily reconciliation of positions, trades, and cash/token balances across centralized exchanges (CeFi), decentralized protocols (DeFi), and OTC counterparties.

- Calculate and substantiate daily P&L across multiple asset types, ensuring valuation methodologies are applied consistently and correctly.

- Investigate and resolve trade breaks, valuation discrepancies, and settlement issues, identifying root causes.

- Build and maintain Python-based tools and notebooks to automate recurring reconciliation, reporting, and analysis workflows.

- Query and manage data across internal databases to support reconciliation, reporting, and ad hoc analysis.

- Synthesize complex, ambiguous situations, including breaks spanning multiple venues, counterparties, or asset types, into clear, streamlined deliverables for traders and senior management.

- Partner with technology teams to scope and prioritize enhancements to reconciliation and valuation systems, and to communicate complex operational issues in a clear, actionable way.

- Gather requirements and data from various stakeholders (Trading, Finance, Risk, Technology) to identify issues and improve Mid Office processes.

Your Skills and Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, STEM, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

- 3+ years of experience in trading operations, middle office, product control, or a related function; crypto/digital asset experience strongly preferred.

- Python skills, including experience with data libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy) and building automated workflows, are a plus.

- Solid understanding of databases and data structures; SQL experience required.

- Familiarity with CeFi, DeFi, and OTC market structure, including exchange APIs, on-chain data, and bilateral settlement, is a strong plus.

- Experience with P&L calculation, trade reconciliation, and valuation concepts across asset types.

- Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data accuracy.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Owner mentality: takes ownership of tasks and projects, with a drive to understand the business beyond own role to add value to the overall business.

postings.title: Network Engineer
postings.description:
Join our forward-thinking team as a Network Engineer, where you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting high-performance, low-latency network infrastructure.
At IMC, the Trading Infrastructure team is responsible for the WAN, LANs, and all low-latency connectivity to trading venues. You will work closely with Systems Engineers, internal teams, and external partners to deliver best-in-class solutions that support our trading business and help evolve our infrastructure to meet the demands of a dynamic industry.

Your Core Responsibilities:

- Design, implement and support the networking infrastructure. Key areas include Low-latency networking, Unicast and Multicast routing, OSPF, BGP, PIM SM, as well as things like QoS, STP, NAT, protocol tuning, etc.

- Monitor, guard and analyze the proper functioning of our network infrastructure. Take adaptive, retentive and corrective measures and perform structural maintenance.

- Proactively improve our infrastructure by contributing scripts and code to our automation efforts (e.g. Bash, Python).

- Accurately create and maintain documentation detailing the implemented network components, as well as relevant procedures and other documentation.

- Responsibility for our IT security related platforms. Key areas include Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, Security policies, etc.

- Work flexible hours. We are proud of the uptime of the trading environment, so every now and then you will be working outside of regular business hours to apply critical changes. This could be from your desk, your couch at home or also inside of one of our datacenters abroad.

- Liaise with external vendors, exchanges and providers to explore new technology solutions, implement new services or troubleshoot problems.

Your Skills and Experience:

- 5+ years of experience as a Network Engineer, with a passion for all aspects of networking

- Proven ability to design, implement, and support high-performance networks

- Strong appetite for accuracy and willingness to go beyond standard textbook networking concepts

- Collaborative mindset with experience working closely across cross-functional teams

- Ability to motivate and encourage peers while maintaining a high technical standard

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

postings.title: Operational Risk Manager
postings.description:
About the role

We're looking for an Operational Risk Manager to join IMC's Operational Risk Management (ORM) team and lead operational risk frameworks and prudential risk across our European offices.

The key focus areas for this role are split between operational risk and prudential risk. Operational risk covers the Key Control Framework (KCF), Risk Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), risk surveys, risk culture, and Business Continuity Planning (BCP). Prudential risk focuses on IFR/IFD regulatory frameworks including the Internal Capital Adequacy and Risk Assessment (ICARA) process, Pillar 3 disclosures, prudential reporting, and participation in IFR-related working groups across associations (EPTA, APT) and regulators (FCA, DNB).

You will partner with Trading, Technology, Compliance, and other teams across the organization to ensure risk controls are appropriately embedded in systems and processes. The role reports to the European Head of Risk and is based in Amsterdam, with regular travel across our European offices (London, Zug, Aarhus). You will join a growing dedicated ORM team as the second member and collaborate with ORM colleagues globally.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

- Own and continuously enhance the Key Control Framework, ensuring effective testing, monitoring, and assurance of critical firm-wide controls

- Conduct annual Risk Survey, Culture assesment and Risk Control Self-Assessment process to ensure proactive and consistent identification, evaluation, and mitigation of key risks

- Partner with Trading, Technology, Compliance and other teams to ensure risk controls are appropriately embedded in systems and processes

- Lead Business Continuity Planning (BCP) processes and testing across European offices

- Lead ongoing IFR/IFD prudential risk management for Amsterdam and London entities

- Own the Internal Capital Adequacy and Risk Assessment (ICARA) process, Pillar 3 disclosures, and prudential reporting for both jurisdictions

- Participate in IFR-related working groups across associations (EPTA, APT) and engage with regulators (FCA, DNB) on prudential risk matters

Your Skills and Experience: 

- At least 5+ years of relevant operational & prudential risk management experience in financial services or trading environments

- Proven experience interpreting prudential risk regulations, translating them into practical implementation, and understanding how they impact the business (IFR/IFD experience preferred)

- Plus when direct experience with ICARA processes, Pillar 3 disclosures, and prudential reporting

- Demonstrated experience developing and implementing Operational Risk frameworks, including RCSA and Key Control frameworks

- Understanding of financial markets, trading operations, and associated risk exposures

- Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and ability to work with complex regulatory requirements

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage credibly at all levels of the organization

- Leadership capabilities with ability to develop and mentor team members

- Academic background in a relevant field (finance, risk management, economics, or related disciplines)

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

postings.title: Operations Analyst – Mid Office
postings.description:
The Middle Office Team at IMC is seeking an Operations Analyst. In this dynamic role, you'll support trade reconciliation and settlement accuracy, help resolve discrepancies, and ensure seamless trade flow across platforms in collaboration with trading and IT teams. As a member of the Middle Office team, you'll build strong foundational knowledge and develop into a go-to resource, learning from senior analysts and contributing to a high standard of operational excellence. You'll play a key role in supporting the trade lifecycle, managing accounts, and calculating P&L, all while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and automation in a fast-paced environment.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

- Perform intraday and next-day trade reconciliation, ensuring accuracy and timeliness across all activity

- Calculate and reconcile daily P&L; reconcile monthly invoices with exchanges, clearing firms, and other counterparties

- Identify and resolve daily trade and settlement breaks; conduct analysis to determine root causes and drive timely corrections at the clearing firm level

- Understand the trade lifecycle, from execution through final settlement, including all associated fees

- Work with IT and Trading to ensure proper trade flow, including onboarding new exchanges, clearing firms, and trading platforms

- Liaise between clearing firms and trading operations; open new accounts and execute position, trade, and cash transfers

- Monitor high-level account balances and margin/collateral requirements in conjunction with the Risk team

- Manage and analyze large datasets; create ad hoc and recurring reports to support operational and business needs

- Maintain an automation mindset, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and efficiency

- Collaborate in cross-functional teams to develop solutions across departments and improve quality and efficiency within support

- Interact daily with other support areas, and build an understanding of key risk, compliance, finance, and legal topics

- Quickly learn new tools, procedures, and structures, and continually look for ways to improve upon them

Your Skills and Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (B.S. preferred)

postings.title: Performance Engineer
postings.description:
As a Performance Engineer at IMC, you will play a pivotal role in analysing, optimising, and tuning our systems' interaction with exchange systems holistically. Working closely with traders and engineers, you'll be tasked with uncovering performance improvements across the trading stack. This role combines technical ingenuity with creative problem-solving to outsmart competition in one of the most demanding technical landscapes.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

- Black Box Reverse Engineering and Analysis: Analyse and understand the behaviour of complex, live systems — such as exchange connectivity and market data feeds — using black-box techniques, with no source code access. Design and run statistical experiments against real data to explain emergent real-world phenomena and identify performance bottlenecks and optimisation opportunities. This is investigative work aimed at systems you can observe but not disassemble, not static binary or malware analysis.

- Experimentation & Prototyping: Design, implement, and build working prototypes to test ideas and technologies quickly — not specifications for others to build from.

- Collaboration & Communication: Liaise effectively with traders, software and hardware engineers, and infrastructure teams to share insights and implement solutions.

- System Analysis: Analyse terabytes of network data using statistical methods to identify patterns, validate hypotheses, and quantify performance improvements.

Your Skills and Experience: 

Most of the following will apply — we don't expect every candidate to check every box:

- Comfortable using statistics and data analysis to test hypotheses at scale, not just qualitative or manual investigation.

- System-level optimisation or low-level network optimisation — ideally applied to live/external systems rather than static binaries.

- Strong understanding of networking, computer internals, and Linux systems.

- Exposure to low-latency hardware technologies such as Intel CPUs, FPGA, or microwave links is a strong plus, though not required.

- Proven commercial experience writing and shipping production code — Python and/or C++ or Java

postings.title: Principal Research Scientist - Machine Learning
postings.description:
IMC is one of the world’s leading trading firms, combining quantitative research, technology and trading expertise to solve complex problems at scale.

As Machine Learning becomes increasingly important within our Systematic Equities business, we are investing in frontier research that can shape the next generation of models, infrastructure and research capabilities. With access to world-class datasets, significant compute resources and a highly collaborative environment, IMC offers a unique opportunity to see cutting-edge research translated into real-world impact.

We are seeking a Principal Research Scientist to help define and accelerate our long-term machine learning research agenda. Prior finance experience is not required.

The Role

This role is designed for an established academic researcher or research scientist who wants to remain connected to the frontier of machine learning while applying their expertise in a highly impactful environment.

You will work alongside quantitative researchers, engineers and research leadership to identify emerging research directions, evaluate new developments in machine learning, and help translate promising academic advances into practical applications.

Rather than owning individual trading strategies, you will act as a scientific leader, mentor and advisor across the research organisation. You will also represent IMC externally through participation in leading conferences and engagement with the broader machine learning community.

Responsibilities

- Shape the long-term machine learning research agenda within Systematic Equities.

- Identify and translate advances from frontier ML research into practical opportunities.

- Conduct original research and develop proof-of-concept solutions where appropriate.

- Advise and mentor quantitative researchers on methodology, experimentation and research direction.

- Help guide future investments in research tooling, infrastructure and compute capabilities.

- Represent IMC within the global machine learning community through conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML and ICLR.

- Contribute to publication efforts where appropriate and consistent with intellectual property considerations.

Skills & Experience

- PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics or a related quantitative discipline.

- Outstanding academic credentials and a strong publication record in leading research venues.

- Demonstrable interest in Financial Markets is required.

- Current or recent experience in a faculty-equivalent academic or research leadership role such as Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, Professor, Group Leader, Principal Investigator, Senior Postdoctoral Researcher, or Senior Research Scientist.

- Deep expertise in modern machine learning and strong awareness of emerging research trends.

- Experience influencing research direction, mentoring researchers, or leading research initiatives.

- Strong programming skills and experience with modern machine learning frameworks.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across disciplines.

What We Offer

- The opportunity to influence the future of machine learning at one of the world’s leading trading firms.

- Access to exceptional datasets, infrastructure and large-scale compute resources.

- Continued engagement with the academic community through conferences, collaborations and publication opportunities.

- A collaborative environment where research can move rapidly from idea to impact.

- Competitive compensation that reflects both scientific excellence and commercial impact.

postings.title: Process Transformation Specialist
postings.description:
IMC is a global trading firm powered by a cutting-edge research environment and a world-class technology backbone. We are re-engineering our Business Operations processes so they are scalable, reliable, and efficient — the baseline we need to automate them and embed AI, including agentic AI, in how our business functions run.

As Process Transformation Specialist you will own that re-engineering end to end: map how processes really run today, redesign them to one global standard, build them into our systems, and embed them so every process is measured, repeatable, and ready for automation.

You'll start in HR & Recruiting, with the core Workday and Greenhouse processes: Hire & Onboarding, Offboarding, Position Management, and Change Job (incl. Mobility). As the method proves itself, you take it across other Business Operations functions, for example Finance, Procurement, and internal service operations.

What you'll do

Run the re-engineering cycle

- Map current-state processes end to end — exceptions, workarounds, handoffs, and the data transfer points between systems and regions. Process owners tell you how it works; you document it.

- Facilitate redesign workshops with functional leads and regional process owners; drive to a single global standard, with local deviation only where there is genuine need.

- Translate future-state designs into system requirements (Workday business processes, Greenhouse workflows, other Business Operations platforms), partnering with HRIS and system owners on the build.

- Define process metrics, establish baselines, and run the continuous-improvement cadence.

Build a process excellence capability across Business Operations

- Establish the reusable framework — standards, BPMN notation, templates, and a process repository — so every cycle gets faster than the last.

- Work with function leads beyond HR to prioritise and scope the next processes to re-engineer.

- Coach process owners so the improvement loop continues without you in the room.

Make processes ready for automation and AI

- Design processes that produce clean, structured data — the foundation for reporting, automation, and AI.

- Identify which steps AI should power, augment, or leave to people, and design the human-in-the-loop checkpoints — the groundwork for embedding agentic AI in our processes.

- Work alongside external partners where they accelerate the work, and transfer the capability in-house.

Land the change

- Plan and support change management: documentation, training, and adoption with teams and managers.

What you bring

- 6+ years in business process re-engineering, process excellence, or operational excellence, using formal methods (Lean, Six Sigma, BPMN, value-stream mapping), with redesigns you have taken through to implementation.

- Redesign experience in at least one Business Operations function, for example HR, Finance, Procurement, or shared services. Experience across several functions, and hire-to-retire in particular, is a strong plus.

- Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms. Working knowledge of Workday business processes (HCM and/or Financials) is a strong plus — if you know the method, we will help you learn the platform.

- Strong facilitation — you run workshops that get senior stakeholders to decisions, and you balance global consistency with local needs.

- Data literacy: you design processes with measurement in mind and are comfortable analysing process data.

- A pragmatic grasp of automation and AI workflow automation, integrations, and AI agents — and good judgement on where they add value.

- A change-management track record. You land redesigns, not just design them.

Nice to have

- Experience in a trading firm, fintech, or other fast-moving technical environment.

- Experience as a global process owner — accountable for a process end to end, not only its design.

- Process mining or modelling tools (e.g. Celonis, SAP Signavio).

- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, BPM, or Workday certification.

- A consulting or enterprise transformation background.

postings.title: Procurement Manager
postings.description:
We are looking for a Procurement Manager to own technology sourcing for IMC India. You will run the full cycle for IT hardware, software, network, data centre and technology services: from understanding what our engineers and traders need, to negotiating with vendors, to managing contracts and renewals.

You will work closely with Technology, Infrastructure, Information Security, Legal, Compliance and Finance in Mumbai, and with IMC's global procurement colleagues in other offices. You will also lead and develop a small team.

Key spend categories: servers, storage and low-latency network hardware; software licences and SaaS; data centre and colocation; telecom and leased lines; cloud services; end-user devices; IT services and support contracts; market data and connectivity. 

Your Core Responsibilities: 

Sourcing and negotiation

- Identify new vendors and service providers in India and globally, building a strong supplier base for each IT category.

- Run end-to-end sourcing for IT categories: requirements, RFI/RFQ/RFP, vendor evaluation, commercial negotiation and award.

- Negotiate pricing, SLAs, support terms, warranties, delivery timelines and licensing models with OEMs, distributors and service providers.

- Manage urgent hardware buys for trading infrastructure, balancing speed with cost and control.

- Reduce single-vendor dependency by identifying and maintaining alternative suppliers for strategic and critical categories

Market intelligence and forward planning

- Track IT market trends, pricing and supply conditions, such as rising memory, storage and GPU costs, component shortages, lead times and currency movements, and brief stakeholders on what they mean for IMC.

- Build close relationships with IT and infrastructure teams to understand upcoming needs early, and with vendors and OEMs to get early sight of price changes, product roadmaps and end-of-life notices.

- Use this insight to anticipate supply constraints and price rises and act ahead of them, for example by timing purchases, securing allocation or locking in pricing, and to spot savings opportunities.

Contracts and vendor management

- Review and negotiate MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, licence agreements and DPAs with Legal.

- Keep a contract register and renewal calendar so no licence, support contract or circuit lapses unplanned.

- Run vendor onboarding, due diligence and periodic performance reviews against SLAs and KPIs.

- Manage relationships with strategic technology vendors and escalate issues when needed.

Risk, compliance and controls

- Work with Information Security and Compliance on third-party risk assessments, especially for vendors with access to systems or data.

- Work with Finance to handle tax aspects of purchases, including GST, TDS, import duties and documentation for imported hardware.

- Keep procurement auditable: approvals, purchase orders, three-way match and documentation ready for internal and external audit.

- Partner with IT on hardware asset lifecycle: procurement, tagging, refresh cycles and compliant disposal (e-waste).

Budget, reporting and team

- Support annual IT budgeting and forecasting with Finance and Technology leads.

- Report on spend, savings, contract status and vendor performance.

- Improve procurement processes and tools, including the purchase-to-pay workflow.

- Lead, coach and develop 1–2 procurement specialists.

Your Skills and Experience: 

- 8–12 years in procurement, with at least 5 years focused on IT or technology categories.

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, supply chain or a related field. An MBA or a certification such as CIPS or CPSM is a plus.

- Solid understanding of IT hardware, networking, software licensing models (perpetual, subscription, enterprise agreements) and cloud pricing.

- Strong negotiation skills and a record of measurable savings and better contract terms.

- Experience drafting and negotiating technology contracts and SLAs.

- Working knowledge of Indian procurement requirements: GST, TDS, import and customs processes, and vendor compliance.

- Experience in financial services, trading, or another regulated, technology-heavy environment is strongly preferred.

- Comfort with ERP and procurement tools [e.g. Workday, Coupa, SAP Ariba] and strong Excel skills.

- Clear communicator who can work with engineers, traders, legal and finance, and with global colleagues across time zones.

- Experience managing or mentoring a small team.

- Experience buying data centre or colocation services, low-latency network equipment or market data.

- Exposure to third-party risk management frameworks and information security questionnaires.

- Experience with software asset management (SAM) tools.

Our 10-week trading internship is your chance to experience life as a trader at IMC. Where you go from here is up to you — the majority of our interns secure a graduate position at the end of the programme.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

From day one, you are immersed in real projects, complex problem-solving, and opportunities to learn from some of the industry’s strongest Traders and Engineers.

- See what it is like to be a Quantitative Trader at IMC; develop your trading skills and systematic trading strategies.

- Work collaboratively in an environment where creativity, teamwork, and innovation are recognised and rewarded.

- Be supported by a mentor who will oversee your progress and professional development.

- Have the opportunity to secure a full-time role with IMC once you graduate.

- The ability to make decisions under uncertainty and remain focused under pressure.

- The ability to commence in May/June 2027.

You will partner closely with recruiters, recruiting coordinators, HRIS, and business stakeholders to lead operational projects, improve day-to-day processes, and identify practical ways to apply AI and automation to manual work.

You bring a recruiter's instinct for what good hiring looks like, a project manager's discipline for getting things done, and genuine curiosity about how technology — especially AI — can remove friction from recruiting. You listen closely to understand the real problem before designing a solution, and you're equally comfortable building relationships inside IMC and staying connected to the external recruiting and HR tech market.

Your Core Responsibilities:

Recruiting Operations & Process Excellence

- Develop, maintain, and reimagine recruiting processes that balance the needs of the business with operational excellence.

- Identify process improvements across recruiting and help build processes and procedures that span multiple regions.

- Manage cross-functional projects from scoping through rollout, keeping timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables on track.

- Collaborate on process documents and ensure that enablement is top of mind and easily accessible to the global teams.

- Partner with the Global Head of Rec Ops to translate strategy into executable plans.

AI, Automation & Technology

- Bring a practical eye for where AI and automation can eliminate manual, repetitive work and free recruiting coordinators, ops specialists, and recruiters for higher-impact activity.

- Build tools, documentation, playbooks, and training that help recruiters and recruiting coordinators work more efficiently and consistently.

- Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (Greenhouse preferred).
