The team
You'll join our Campus Recruitment team in Europe, based in Amsterdam, part of a wider recruitment organisation of experienced tech, trading and business support recruiters. Collaboration comes first here: we share knowledge, step in for each other in peak season, and succeed as one team.

What you'll do

- Own the end-to-end recruitment process: screening, interviewing, assessment review, offer conversations and closing

- Build strong partnerships with business leaders and interviewers, and make sure we're aligned on hiring needs and on what great looks like

You will work in close collaboration with our Technology and Trading teams, as well as Procurement, Finance, Corporate Development, Treasury, Risk and Compliance, to drive business growth and operational excellence.

This is an opportunity for an experienced commercial and technology lawyer to step into a senior, commercially critical role – combining deep legal expertise with sharp judgement and a practical, solutions-focused mindset. You will be trusted to run matters independently, influence decision-making and help shape best-in-class commercial legal practices within a business that values precision, speed and innovation.

- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Technology, Trading and business operations, working effectively at pace.

You will operate as the commercial counterpart to our infrastructure engineering leadership as we scale high-performance compute for both trading infrastructure and large-scale AI research clusters.

This role requires deep domain expertise in technology hardware procurement and market dynamics: GPU and accelerated compute platforms, server architectures, high-performance networking, component supply chains, allocation and lead-time dynamics, and OEM/ODM/channel commercial models.

- Own and execute the global hardware category strategy — GPU/accelerated compute, servers, networking, storage hardware, and enterprise equipment — across trading infrastructure and large-scale research compute environments

- Build and own executive-level relationships with strategic hardware vendors representing $300M–$500M+ in annual spend, including executive sponsorship programs, quarterly business reviews, roadmap and allocation alignment, and long-term partnership frameworks

postings.title: Senior Tax Manager
postings.description:
Our APAC Tax team works closely with our Trading, Technology, Finance, Strategy and Legal teams to manage the tax position of IMC's business activities across the Asia-Pacific region. As a Senior Tax Manager at IMC, you will be the go-to tax advisor for the business, focusing primarily on the tax implications of new trading strategies, products, markets and structures. The role combines a strong advisory focus with hands-on ownership of tax compliance and reporting for our APAC entities. Reporting to our Head of Tax, APAC, you will also work with our global tax colleagues across the group on cross-border and group-wide matters.

Your Core Responsibilities:

- Partnering with Trading and Technology to advise on the tax implications of new trading strategies, financial instruments, venues and markets across APAC.

- Analysing trading-related direct and indirect taxes, including dividend withholding tax, stamp duties, financial transaction taxes and treaty positions.

- Advising on entity structuring, new market entry, licensing, restructurings, and strategic investments or acquisitions.

- Managing the APAC transfer pricing policy and intercompany arrangements, and assessing permanent establishment risk.

- Assessing the impact of tax law changes across APAC and translating them into clear recommendations for the business.

- Involvement with APAC tax incentive and R&D applications.

- 8+ years of tax experience, with a strong advisory focus, gained at a Big 4, top-tier law or advisory firm and/or in-house at a bank, trading firm, asset manager or other financial institution.

- Ability to turn complex tax analysis into clear, practical advice for traders, engineers and senior management.

postings.title: Software Engineer (Java) - Global Research Platform
postings.description:
We are seeking a driven Java engineer to join our global research platform team in Mumbai. The team builds and operates the compute and data platform that powers all of IMC's quantitative research: a large-scale Kubernetes-based research cluster, a distributed job scheduling platform used by every trading and research team, and the market-data and dataset services that feed research on it. Mumbai runs one of the platform's regional production deployments, and you'll collaborate closely with platform colleagues in Amsterdam, Chicago and Sydney. 

Your Core Responsibilities: 

- Design, build and operate the Java backend of our distributed job scheduling platform: the job controller and state machine, scheduling integrations, resource and cost tracking, and the failure-recovery machinery that keeps research workloads running at scale

- Develop gRPC/protobuf APIs consumed by Python, Java and C++ clients across the firm

- Build event-driven services on Kafka for job lifecycle tracking, data lineage, and dataset orchestration

- Work hands-on with Kubernetes at scale: pod scheduling, fair-share queueing, preemption and multi-cluster placement

- 

Instrument, monitor and firefight production systems, and drive root-cause analysis of performance bottlenecks

- 

Support and consult research users in the India office

Your Skills and Experience: 

- 3+ years of professional Java development experience (Java 17+, Maven/Gradle, strong grasp of concurrency and JVM performance)

- 

2+ year of hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker (building on the K8s API is a strong plus)

- 

Comfortable developing in Python; our client libraries and research users are Python-first, and you'll work on both sides of the API

- Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: state machines, retries/idempotency, event-driven architectures, consistency trade-offs

- Experience with workload scheduling or batch/compute orchestration systems (e.g. Kubernetes schedulers, Slurm, YARN, Kueue, Ray, Airflow)

- Experience with messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka

- Working knowledge of NoSQL and time-series/SQL databases (e.g. MongoDB, PostgreSQL)

- Experience with gRPC/protobuf or similar RPC frameworks is a plus

- Strong Linux fundamentals and scripting (bash, Python)

- Experience with monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, alerting) and comfort operating what you build

- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across the stack from application code through Kubernetes to network and storage

- Exposure to object storage (S3) or high-performance data formats (Parquet, Iceberg)

postings.title: Software Engineer - Machine Learning Frameworks
postings.description:
The Machine Learning Frameworks team exists for two reasons: making the research iteration loop as fast and frictionless as possible, and making production run as fast as the hardware allows. Both matter, and figuring out how to do both at once is most of what makes the work fun.

Concretely, we build optimisers, code generators, runtime libraries, and the orchestration layer that runs computation across heterogeneous hardware. The stack spans C++, Rust, Python, MLIR, and CUDA. You don't need to know all of these things but should want to work at this level of the stack.

The work is broad. Some of it is high-level, looking at the whole compute pipeline, orchestrating the system and creating a cohesive product. Some of it is in the details, getting into hardware behaviour, dissecting compute graphs, squeezing the last bit of performance out of the hot path. Our job is managing the whole stack, top to bottom.

About you

- You write production code in a systems language. C++ or Rust, or something close enough that picking them up isn't the hard part. The right tool matters more to you than your favourite one

- You like understanding what a language compiles down to and how it runs on hardware.

- You're comfortable being handed an unfamiliar part of the stack and working it out.

- You like working with stakeholders and you’re good at figuring out what someone actually needs, not just what they asked for

- You've done this commercially. You've owned something in production that other people relied on. Not necessarily big, but something you had to maintain, debug and live with long after you shipped it.

What you don't need

A finance background. Exposure to every language we touch. We hire engineers who like to solve the problems our traders face - we'll teach you the context on the ground

postings.title: Systems Engineer - Global Development Platform
postings.description:
Systems Engineer - Global Development Platform

The Platform Engineering organization at IMC Trading is focused on accelerating tech team workflows through providing self-service tools, services, documentation, and support. Platform Engineering is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the underlying runtime platforms that IMC’s software applications depend on. The mission is to streamline development processes, establish a consistent technical foundation across regions, and empower teams with the necessary resources to innovate efficiently.

Platform Engineering is a global team and acts as a bridge between the technical requirements of application development and the practical aspects of deploying and maintaining those applications in a production environment, minimizing friction, and ensuring that tech teams can operate seamlessly and drive progress forward.

The way software gets built is changing fast. AI-assisted and agent-driven development has significantly increased development volume across the firm, and our systems are feeling it. We see this as an opportunity: rather than simply scaling to keep up, we’re using AI and automation to transform how we operate our developer platform.

The Platform Engineering team is seeking a versatile, hands-on Systems Engineer in Chicago, where our core build infrastructure lives, to play a critical role in enhancing and optimizing our developer services infrastructure. You will join a highly experienced global team that supports a wide array of critical systems, including source control, continuous integration pipelines, artifact repositories, and observability tools, all of which are vital to the stability and performance of our trading platforms and are used by software engineering, research, and trading teams across IMC.

Your Core Responsibilities:

- Optimize and enhance the reliability, scalability, and performance of our development services infrastructure, including artifact repositories (Nexus), CI systems (TeamCity, Jenkins), source control (GitLab), and Bazel remote execution clusters.

- Administer and oversee source control systems, continuous integration services and build agents, artifact repositories, metrics, logging, observability tools, and related systems across multiple data centers and regions, both in on-premises environments and leveraging AWS cloud services.

- Drive operational excellence through failover and redundancy, capacity planning, and clear, well-maintained runbooks for every service.

- Diagnose and resolve production incidents swiftly, supporting Global Operations in a ‘follow the sun’ model and working with regional peers to guarantee continuous 24/7 system availability.

- Help build our on-call and paging practices from the ground up as more markets and teams move to 24/7, with the goal of quiet, highly automated operations.

- Identify and eliminate system performance bottlenecks and drive uptime improvements through proactive automation, monitoring, and performance tuning, including using AI to automate operational work.

- Support newer platform services, such as our AI model gateway (LiteLLM).

- Integrate and deploy new Cloud SaaS solutions, collaborating cross-functionally to deliver innovative tools and functionalities to our teams.

- Partner with development teams globally to align system capabilities with their evolving needs, ensuring seamless operations and support and boosting organizational efficiency.

Your Skills and Experience:

- 1-3 years of work experience in a relevant role (SRE, platform, DevOps, infrastructure, or similar)

- Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent

- Strong programming experience in Python or Go; shell scripting is a plus

- Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix systems

- Experience in operating and enhancing services across various environments, designing and implementing disaster recovery plans, high availability (HA) configurations, and failover strategies

- Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools, including Kubernetes and Docker

- Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or TeamCity, including managing build agents and automating build, test, and deployment processes

- Understanding of security principles and best practices, including experience managing secrets and compliance frameworks

- A self-starter and doer: give you a problem and you’ll go figure it out

- Strong communicator who enjoys working with many different teams and adapting how you engage with each

Nice to Have:

- Experience at a startup or scale-up where you wore many hats and built systems from scratch

- Experience in a fast-paced environment such as trading or financial services

- Interest in applying LLMs and AI to operations (no prior experience required; we’ll help you learn)

Why You’ll Love This Role:

- A front-row seat to a shift in the industry. Agent-driven development is changing how software is built, and you’ll help define how platform operations keep pace, using AI to do it.

- Real ownership. You’ll be one of the key people in Chicago who understands how our build infrastructure runs end to end, with direct influence on its direction.

- Global impact. Your work supports engineering, research, and trading teams across all of IMC’s offices.

- Startup energy, established firm. IMC has big ambitions and is growing fast, and the change in this space over the past year has been bigger than in the previous five.

No two onboardings are identical, and the person in this role will make a considerable impact as the firm scales its client business.

- Validate client connectivity and routing setup.

- Coordinate the process across legal, compliance, clearing, infrastructure, development, and business teams.

- Ensure internal readiness across data, pricing, strategy configuration, and client setup.

postings.description:
IMC has a strong presence in traditional finance and has been expanding its cryptocurrency trading activities over recent years. Through its global affiliates, IMC provides liquidity and trades across a broad range of cryptocurrency exchanges and DeFi protocols. 
We are currently looking for a Crypto Trader to join us in Sydney office and provide APAC-hours coverage for our Crypto team in Zug. Working during normal Sydney business hours, you will take ownership of live trading activities while the Zug-based team is offline.
The role covers token market making, DeFi, and CeFi delta-one strategies. It is primarily focused on operating, monitoring, configuring, and managing the risk of automated trading strategies.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

- Monitor live trading strategies, positions, exposures, and PnL during APAC hours.

- Manage strategy configurations, trading parameters, limits, and operational controls.

- Investigate urgent trading issues, unexpected strategy behaviour, and unusual PnL movements.

- Take appropriate action during volatile markets, exchange incidents, or infrastructure disruptions.

- Use Python and internal tools to analyse trades, execution quality, and strategy performance.

- Support the rollout and scaling of strategies across new tokens, venues, and protocols.

- Provide clear handovers between the Sydney and Zug teams.

- Communicate with external parties to resolve issues and handle requests.

Your Skills and Experience: 

- A quantitative or technical background in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Good judgement and attention to detail when working with live trading systems.

- Ability to remain calm and make decisions during time-sensitive incidents.

- Proficiency in Python for data analysis and trade investigations.

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

Good to Have:

- Experience in electronic trading, market making, trading operations, or risk management.

- Familiarity with cryptocurrency markets, including spot, perpetual futures, funding, and hedging.

- Exposure to DeFi protocols or automated trading systems.

- Familiarity with SQL, Linux, logs, and monitoring tools.

Prior experience developing low-latency trading strategies is not required. However, candidates should be comfortable understanding quantitative strategies, investigating their behaviour, and working closely with the traders, researchers, and developers responsible for them.

postings.title: Trading Data Software Engineer
postings.description:
At IMC, technology is not a department; it’s at the heart of everything we do. Developed in house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition.

IMC’s Amsterdam-based Global VMM Data team works on a centralised global data platform to serve high-quality curated data for Valuation Market Making (VMM) research and strategies all throughout IMC. We address the ever changing data requirements and our team tries to solve this in a young project building a central system to ingest, curate and expose data to our research tooling within IMC.

Your Core Responsibilities:

As a Trading Data Software Engineer, you'll work on enabling high-quality research using fundamental option pricing data. Next to that you will increase researchers' focus by centralising the curation of the data and enable quick onboarding of new data sets, to allow for researching new types of strategies that are going to play a vital role in the strategies of IMC now and in the future. We build the tooling that allows a team of data curators to perform their magic and on top of that we expose our data to research tooling to provide a global access.

You’ll write reliable, high-performance software while balancing time to production with quality and testability. Advanced automated testing and daily deployments will allow you to achieve agile and incremental benefits. Within the complex landscape of IMC and its systems and technologies, you’ll be constantly challenged to consider trade-offs between latency, throughput, simplicity, scalability and maintainability. Your core tasks will include:

- Coding, developing, testing, deploying and maintaining applications and automations for data curators, other VMM developers and Traders/researchers to support them and understand their actual needs and the data we serve them.

- Working on a young project and being involved of the architectural design of our system.

- Building a system that is highly-performant at serving petabytes of data globally.

Your Skills and Experience:

- At least > 4 years of experience as a Software Engineer 

- Strong programming skills in Java (11+), but experience in the latest versions of Java is highly desirable

- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes and Linux

- Strong programming skills with Python, especially around data - highly preferred

- Experience working in data analysis and building out data platforms and data - highly preferred

- The ability able to work under minimal supervision and to take full ownership of the applications you build

- Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills; ability to solve problems creatively and proactively

- Prior knowledge of trading / capital markets is not required. Curiosity and a willingness to learn is.

Our tech stack includes an ever-evolving range of systems and technologies, and our engineers have the freedom to choose the best solution for the problem at hand. If a new technology has the potential to add value, we’ll actively invest in exploring, adopting and developing it.

postings.title: Trading Engineer - Execution
postings.description:
We are looking for a multi-talented and passionate Trading Systems Engineer to join our execution development team. In this role, you will take ownership of systems that sit directly in the critical path of live trading, handling everything from hardware and network connectivity to application performance and exchange interactions. This is not a pure support role — and it’s not purely project-based engineering either. It’s intentionally both. You will split your time between:

- Operational support of live trading systems, ensuring stability and rapid resolution of production issues. This portion of the role is fast-paced, highly visible and requires strong troubleshooting instincts, clear communication, and the ability to remain calm under pressure. If you enjoy solving real-time problems and seeing immediate impact from your work, this is for you.

- Project-based engineering work, improving the reliability, performance, and automation of those same systems. The goal is simple: fewer incidents, faster recovery, more proactive monitoring, and stronger systems over time. We believe production ownership and engineering improvement go hand in hand — the best way to improve a system is to deeply understand how it behaves under real-world pressure.

Our execution systems are fundamental to our success and require dedicated ownership to ensure continuity throughout the trading day. You will play a key role in both optimizing today’s trading and building a continuously better platform for tomorrow.

Your Core Responsibilities:

- Participate in structured support rotations to provide real-time coverage for critical execution systems

- Ensure continuity of trading operations, prioritizing and resolving system issues with urgency and composure

- Diagnose novel production incidents, often coordinating across trading, development, infrastructure, and external exchanges

- Monitor system performance and proactively identify risks before they impact trading

- Build automation tools for system orchestration and operational efficiency

- Eliminate recurring issues through root cause analysis and durable fixes

- Partner with technology and trading teams to refine and deploy system architecture

- Enhance monitoring, observability, and resiliency

- Support and optimize core market connectivity

Your Skills and Experience:

- Passion for problem solving and new technologies.

- 2-5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Systems Integration, Production Engineering, or a related role in a heavily on-prem environment

- 2-5+ years of hands-on experience with Linux operating systems, network configuration, and server management

- Strong understanding of network fundamentals, including routing protocols, TCP/UDP, multicast, network offload, and kernel bypass technology

- Proficiency in Python and Bash

- Demonstrated curiosity and hands-on experimentation with technology—whether through personal projects, home labs, open source contributions, or deep-dive exploration of operating systems and networking

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering discipline (or equivalent practical experience)
